description: Search indexed code symbol definitions, file paths, and reference memories within a namespace (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { results, total_candidates } capped at 20 ranked { memory, score } hits. Requires code memories in namespace (populated via /memoreal-sync-code or encode_memory) and rejects reserved "org:" prefixes. Use to discover where functions, classes, or routes live by keyword; use explain_code instead to inspect callers and invariants of a known symbol, or recall_memories for general prose rules.

namespace.description: Logical repository or workspace namespace to search (never prefix with "org:").

query.description: Function, class, route, or file keyword to locate.

name: search_code

results.description: Top ranked { memory, score } code hits (max 20).

total_candidates.description: Total candidate entries scanned in the namespace.

title: Search Indexed Code Memories
